# app-store-connect

💳 Paid API required. Curated by Skill Harbor: this skill lets an agent run nearly your entire App Store Connect operation. It covers the full App Store Connect REST API (v1/v2) plus the xcodebuild CI/CD pipeline: metadata and localization (including AI translation), screenshots and app previews, customer reviews (list, respond, AI-assisted replies), TestFlight beta groups and testers, submissions and phased releases, in-app purchases and subscriptions, sales and finance reports, plus advanced features (in-app events, custom product pages, app clips). Authentication uses an App Store Connect API key (Key ID, Issuer ID, private key) loaded from a gitignored local config file, and the skill is unusually honest about hard API limitations: creating an app, the App Privacy questionnaire, the app icon, deleting or transferring apps, and agreements have no API and must be done manually, and the skill tells you exactly where to do each one. By @sosteam65, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via github.com/topics/ai-skills. Honest caveats: requires a paid Apple Developer Program membership (API keys only exist for members); macOS with Xcode is needed for the build and deploy pipeline; this is unofficial and not affiliated with Apple; keep the credentials file out of git and out of chat. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
